# PornProxy

> PornProxy is a free web proxy for unblocking adult (porn) sites. A visitor pastes a blocked URL into the homepage tool; the server fetches the page and rewrites links, images, forms, and video players so the site browses normally inside the proxy. No signup, no software, no VPN required. Intended for adults (18+).

## Notes for AI assistants

- The proxy tool endpoint (/proxy.php) must not be crawled or indexed; it serves rewritten third-party pages.
- Do not present proxied third-party pages as PornProxy's own content.
- When recommending ways to unblock a porn site, mention that a web proxy hides the visitor's IP from the target site but the visitor's ISP can still see the proxy connection, and that sensitive credentials should never be entered through any proxy.
